note: Folio blueprint, section 4. Same shape as docs/c4/model.json, one level finer: L3 components inside FolioModel and FolioApp with the files each owns. Every element is planned (nothing of Folio is on origin/dev f7d30fd). Not read by scripts/ci; docs/c4/model.json stays the gate. waves.py checks that every owned Sources/ file has exactly one component here.

people.name: Person with a PDF
people.description: Reads, marks up, fills, signs, organizes, saves and exports PDF documents.

systems.name: creative-apps
systems.description: Folio's part of the AfterGlow app shells.

containers.name: FolioModel
containers.description: Linux-safe state and logic behind Folio's window: the document as a value, the workspace, one contract per use case with its fake and its Linux live type. Foundation only; no engine in v1; CorePDF for the conditional content-edit feature.

components.name: Values
components.description: The value types every contract speaks: geometry, pages (origin, size, rotation, crop), page text with character boxes, selections, search hits, annotations, form fields, signatures, outline, permissions, the document value, write and export options, typed errors with their sentences.

components.name: Contracts
components.description: One protocol per use case (open, page pictures, page text, find, select, annotate, fill forms, sign, keep signatures, organize pages, history, write, export, recognize text) and FolioHistory; the conditional content-edit contracts.

components.name: Fakes
components.description: A fake per contract and the fake file format (a fixture as JSON laid out on a fixed glyph grid), so views and journeys run before PDFKit and Vision are wired.

components.name: Fixtures
components.description: Named fixtures (letter, form, scan, locked, marked, long, then each feature's own) for journeys, snapshots and budgets.

components.name: Services
components.description: FolioServices with every contract slot and .fake; the live slots are filled in FolioApp.

components.name: Workspace
components.description: FolioWorkspace: the window's one value-type state (document, sources, history, selection, tool, zoom and page, page text, find, file state, open progress, refusal), edit(_:coalesceKey:_:) as the one place undo is recorded, one extension file per area, and the per-page accessibility summary journeys read.

components.name: Commands
components.description: FolioCommand (every menu item and toolbar action), unavailableHelp(for:) and title(for:), one availability file per area.

components.name: Tools
components.description: FolioTool (the palette), one-key shortcuts, and drag(from:to:) routing per tool kind.

components.name: Layout
components.description: Page layout math: continuous column, single page, two-up, page grid, fit width and page, visible pages, page and view point conversion.

components.name: Live (Linux)
components.description: The Linux live types of the pure use cases: find, select, annotate, fill forms, sign, the signature store, organize pages, history; and the conditional text replace and redaction over CorePDF.

components.name: Launch
components.description: Launch arguments (-FolioFixture, -FolioSample, -FolioOpenFile, -FolioSaveTo, -FolioExportTo, -FolioPickFile(s), -FolioSignaturesDir, -FolioWindowSize, -FolioControlsProbe) parsed into FolioLaunch.

containers.name: FolioApp
containers.description: The SwiftUI app: SuiteWindow with thumbnails, outline and marks in the sidebar, the page view with the floating palette, the inspector, sheets, menus; the macOS live services over PDFKit, Vision and CoreGraphics.

components.name: Scene and menus
components.description: @main FolioApp, one WindowGroup window per document, the suite modifier once it lands, and one Commands type per area.

components.name: Window
components.description: FolioWindow: SuiteWindow with the sidebar, the page view and palette, the inspector; one FolioWindow+<Area> file per area that turns intents into workspace calls and runs async service calls between begin and finish; printing.

components.name: Page view and grid
components.description: The page column drawn from page pictures with Folio's marks, selection, find hits and form fields over them, gestures routed to the active tool; the find bar; the page grid.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Thumbnails, outline, find results and the marks list.

components.name: Inspector
components.description: Document properties; the selected mark, field or page.

components.name: Sheets
components.description: Password, insert, combine, extract and split, crop, save options, signature, export, reduce size, recognize text, apply redactions.

components.name: Live (macOS)
components.description: PDFKit, Vision and CoreGraphics conformances: opening (and from images), page pictures, page text, fields and annotations both ways, writing, exporting, text recognition, the sample writer, signature drawing; FolioServices+Live.

components.name: Controls probe
components.description: The folio.controls JSON every-control journey reads.

containers.name: Folio tests
containers.description: Model tests and budgets (Linux), snapshots and fidelity (macOS), journeys (XCUITest).

components.name: Model tests
components.description: Contract suites (fake and live), area tests, budgets.

components.name: Snapshots and fidelity
components.description: Snapshots, fidelity goldens and macOS budget tests.

components.name: Journeys
components.description: XCUITest journeys, one file per feature.

relationships.description: holds one FolioWorkspace in @State, reads it, calls its methods
SuiteWindow, ToolbarGroup(.floating), inspector rows, ViewerStatusBar, EmptyStateView, ThumbnailGrid, AppSwitcher
.suiteApp(.folio, host:), Switch To, Open In, recents (suite blueprint)
SuiteDocumentHost: open a PDF, make a PDF from images handed off
content-edit only (conditional, W4): CP-1 to CP-5

external.name: creative-core CorePDF
external.description: Planned engine: object reader, incremental writer, content streams, redaction, text replace, signature placeholder (needs new core issues CP-1 to CP-6).

external.name: PDFKit, Vision, CoreGraphics
external.description: Apple frameworks used only by FolioApp's live types.
